content:
incident-bot: Paging alert triggered for AtlasCorp (EU dedicated pool). Severity: P1 - degraded routing causing 503s for account-specific keys. Incident link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-1745
Alice Chen: I'm oncall, investigating routing logs. Pulling sampler of 5xx traces now.
Miguel Santos: Priya, Tom - can we confirm which AtlasCorp endpoints and primary contacts? I have paging on my phone.
Priya Patel: AtlasCorp contacts: eng-lead@atlascorp.com (Marina O'Neil), infra@atlascorp.com (ops-team). Primary AM is priya.patel@redwood.com (that's me). I'll draft customer note.
Tom Rivera: Noted. Mapping: account id a-98765 -> EU-dedicated-1. Affected routes: /v1/generate, /v1/embeddings.
Jules Fournier: Initial hypothesis: autoscaler failed to provision burst capacity due to quota check. Seeing repeated 429->503 in autoscale logs.
Nina Okada: I can spin a warm pool instance in eu-west-1 if we need to route. Waiting on approval.
Alice Chen: Runbook step 2: failover route to fallback model variant `rwd-medium-v2-fallback` and enable steady batch size 8. Miguel, can you approve manual failover?
Miguel Santos: Approve. Do it now. :thumbsup:
Alice Chen: Executed: routing-rule updated. Command used:
```
redwoodctl route update --account a-98765 --from dedicated-eu-1 --to fallback-eu-1 --model rwd-medium-v2-fallback --force
```
Alice Chen: Seeing drop in 503s from 14%->3% over last 2 mins. Still monitoring.
Priya Patel: Draft customer message (short):
"We detected a service disruption impacting AtlasCorp's EU dedicated inference; brief errors from 09:12 - ongoing. We're routing traffic to a fallback model and expect stabilized service within 30 minutes. Primary contacts: Marina O'Neil (marina@atlascorp.com). Will update at 15 and when resolved. - Priya"
Tom Rivera: Add impact specifics: some requests returned truncated responses; embeddings impacted for seq>1024.
Jules Fournier: Postmortem notes to collect: autoscaler logs, quota check errors, kernel selection telemetry for rwd-large-v1.
Nina Okada: I'll prepare temporary step to increase pool buffer:
```
kubectl scale deployment eu-dedicated-warmpool --replicas=6 -n inference
```
Miguel Santos: Notify SRE oncall to be ready for rollback if fallback degrades quality.
Alice Chen: Oncall handoff in 40m to Jules. Current state: partial mitigation in place, customer notified draft sent to Marina, response pending. 
Priya Patel: Sent to Marina with subject "Redwood - Service impact: EU Dedicated". Marina ack'd, asked for ETA and whether any data was at risk.
Alice Chen: No customer data exposure. ETA 25-40m for full restoration; will update status page.
incident-bot: Status page updated: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1745001234 - state: mitigated (partial). Next update scheduled in 15m.
